children.content: Escher demo shape: a 240×140px box filled #7aa2f7. This page is static HTML rendered by escher-web's SSG path (Anvil's /shape command, via escher_web::ssg::render_page_to_html) -- not a live game canvas or Unity view. The same description is also compiled to Unity UXML/USS (Assets/UI/Generated/Shape.{uxml,uss} in Aby's Unity project) but nothing loads or displays it in a running Unity scene yet -- that file just sits on disk for a human to wire up manually.
